verdict.rationale: Browserbase documents creating an Agent from the dashboard by describing a goal in natural language, then deploying and running it on Browserbase on a schedule or on demand. Agents can run continuously, and webhooks push run status to your endpoint, so automations execute unattended in the background. missing for 10: in-depth scheduling documentation (recurrence/cron configuration details beyond a one-line mention), independent or hands-on corroboration of scheduled background runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Deploy and run browser agents on Browserbase, on a schedule or on demand.
Create your Browserbase Agent from the dashboard by describing the goal in natural language.
Run agents that click through your product continuously and alert you the moment something breaks.
Browserbase webhooks send an HTTP POST to an endpoint you own as soon as a subscribed event happens, so you don't have to poll the API for status changes.
